howItWorks.title: From search to seat in 4 steps

step1.d: Pick cities and date. Compare price, bus type and departure window in real time.

step2.d: See the live seat map with VIP and accessible rows marked clearly. Everything in MMK.

step3.d: Add each traveller's full name, phone and National ID (NRC) — required to issue your ticket.

step4.d: Secure payment confirms instantly. Your QR ticket appears in My bookings.

about.description: T-M-T is a modern car & bus ticketing platform built for how people actually travel. We connect passengers with verified operators through live seat maps, honest prices, and tickets you can trust.

whyBuilt.title: Why we built it
whyBuilt.p1: Booking a journey used to mean phone calls, guesswork and a paper ticket you could lose. We set out to make it as simple as ordering a ride — clear options, a real seat map, and a confirmation you can hold in your hand.
whyBuilt.p2: Behind the scenes that means real engineering: atomic seat holds, server-verified fares, signed payments and an auditable trail for every operator and every ticket.

honestPricing.d: The price you see is the price you pay. Fares are always derived server-side — never the client.

noOverselling.d: Atomic seat holds mean the seat you reserve is the seat you get. Inventory stays truthful.

builtForMyanmar.d: Local routes, local operators, National ID (NRC) aware, and payments your travellers already use.
